about.title: A Sacred Home of Lord Laxminarayan
about.p1: Shree Laxminarayan Mandir is a revered Sri Vaishnava temple in Hetauda dedicated to Lord Laxminarayan — the divine union of Vishnu and Lakshmi.
about.p2: The temple follows the Totadri sampradaya, preserving ancient Vaishnava traditions through daily rituals, grand festivals, and religious education rooted in Vedic culture.
about.p3: All poojas are conducted in strict accordance with the Pancharatra Agama shastra, honoring the teachings of Thodadri Nambi and the Alvars.

services.title: Seva & Spiritual Services
services.poojaDesc: Reserve special poojas and homams performed by trained priests for your family's wellbeing.
services.archanaDesc: Offer flowers and prayers with your name, gothram, and nakshatra to Lord Laxminarayan.
services.libraryDesc: Read and download Vedic scriptures, stotras, and texts in Sanskrit, Nepali, and English.
services.bhajansDesc: Listen to devotional bhajans, ashtapadis, and mangalashtak compositions with lyrics.
